# DrawImage <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Images](BlitzBasic-Images)

</div>


```blitzbasic
DrawImage:Void image:Int32, x:Int32, y:Int32, frame:Int32=0
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `image` | In | Int32 | required | The image to draw. |
| `x` | In | Int32 | required | Horizontal position of the handle of the image. |
| `y` | In | Int32 | required | Vertical position of the handle of the image. |
| `frame` | In | Int32 | `0` | Which frame to draw. Defaults to 0. |

## Description

Draws a frame of an image at a position. The handle of the image, which is its top left corner unless [HandleImage](HandleImage), [MidHandle](MidHandle) or [AutoMidHandle](AutoMidHandle) says otherwise, ends up at the position. Pixels with the mask color of the image (black unless [MaskImage](MaskImage) changed it) are left out, so the picture can have any shape. Drawing is clipped by the viewport, and the [Origin](Origin) moves it.

## Differences

* A frame number that does not exist stops the program with an error message.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
Local ball = CreateImage(40, 40)
SetBuffer ImageBuffer(ball)
Color 255, 120, 0
Oval 0, 0, 40, 40, 1
Color 255, 230, 160
Oval 8, 6, 12, 12, 1
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
Cls
For i = 0 To 7
	DrawImage ball, 20 + i * 36, 100 + Sin(i * 45) * 50
Next
Flip
WaitKey
```
